capacity.dataMaximum: total minus explicit control reserve on each axis
capacity.controlMaximum: explicit control reserve on each axis
capacity.checkedArithmetic: nonnegative safe integers; compare remaining capacity before addition

admissionResult.canonical: every resource admission requires an exact claimed OwnedResidentAdmission and installs its original typed result before returning step plus owner/page/reader/slot/record or null
admissionResult.capacityRefusal: blocked with null; no new registration or resource mutation
admissionResult.constructorFailure: rejected with the original already registered facade; its admission cell retains the exact first arbitrary fault root, while intrinsic storage can retire separately
admissionResult.outerWrapperFailure: concrete parent recovers its preheld exact cell result and hands the caught root to retainFailure on a separate granted turn; original pending cell is recoverable after bootstrap wrapper failure
admissionResult.bootstrap: prepareAdmission(exactConsumer, partition, grant), read preparedAdmission(exactConsumer), parent stores exact cell, claimAdmission(exactConsumer, cell, grant)
admissionResult.faultCustody: first exact root only; no clear/refund while held; each resource's own admission guards forward allocation/write/seal/fence/read/admission independently of its parent; distinct subsequent thrown root remains the concrete caller obligation and is not overwritten or silently discarded
admissionResult.terminalAliasDetach: resource intrinsic release retains its charged 8-byte admission link; a separate 64-byte cell turn detaches both aliases and releases that 8-byte charge; cell refund is a later turn

logicalRecords.meaning: fixed logical state/facade records, not measured JS heap sizes; one composition ledger root is outside admitted descendants
logicalRecords.witnessTiming: charge and strongly install before finalization, storage retirement or refund
logicalRecords.terminalFacade: released intrinsic storage and registration credit does not certify collection of externally retained empty facades or immutable proofs

external.adopt: intrinsic fixed ArrayBuffer brand/extent plus actual transfer and checked detachment; no typed-array subview or structural reader
external.transferBeforeViewFailure: retain exact moved backing; no custody receipt; bounded close remains serviceable
external.faultedPostedLateDelivery: already-posted exact backing may enter retirement-only custody after own admission fault; never a live receipt, new reader, public byte or length access
external.controlCorrelation: actor-owned; intrinsic custody does not prove worker/request/lifetime
external.noResponseClose: unimplemented until exact concrete transport-close witness is joined

domainRecord.envelope: explicit checked bytes/slots/owners, added to intrinsic record metadata before construction
metadataParts: 8-byte admission link until separate alias detachment
domainRecord.capabilityOwner: concrete typed composition private state; never a public domain facade property
domainRecord.install: one exact shell strongly installed before fallible field construction/finalization
domainRecord.matchesLiveShell: exact installed shell plus original ledger, record and claimed admission all live and unfaulted; matchesShell alone remains identity-only for close recovery
domainRecord.neutralClose: blocks while shell installed; does not enumerate or invoke the shell
domainRecord.detach: private composition verifies real domain terminal witness, then exact capability detaches only its original shell
domainRecord.detachObservation: preadmitted exact record-and-shell observation survives detach-then-wrapper-throw; replay mutation rejects without regranting domain authority
domainRecord.refund: separate granted intrinsic unlink after detachment; empty unused reservation has distinct path
domainRecord.terminalClaim: intrinsic registration only, never domain terminal proof

implementationStatus: intrinsic owner/page/reader/external/record admissions require held cells; standalone wrapper/fault/terminal-alias tests; UI and actor consumers still adopting the new canonical signatures
